verdict.rationale: Feitian keys come with management tools (SK Manager, iePassManager, OTP Tool), so asking whether a programmatic interface matches those tools is a fair question for this product. The evidence documents no management API, SDK or CLI with UI parity, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec. WebAuthn/HID compatibility and building OpenSK firmware are standard protocols and developer building blocks, not an API that mirrors the management UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
